How to Delete Your OnlyFans Account

You delete an OnlyFans account in a browser, after the money and the files are dealt with. The profile goes, and some records stay, especially if you earned money or someone else already paid for the month.

Dark-Ero editorialUpdated 2026-11-1018+

At a glance

There is no app. The delete control is on the website.

Fans should turn renewals off first. Creators should withdraw, because pending earnings wait seven days.

A creator account stays up until the last paid subscription expires.

Key takeaways

  • Wallet credits are non-refundable, so spend or accept them before you delete.
  • OnlyFans does not describe a pause button. A break is renewals off and a logout.
  • Co-authored posts on someone else's page are not removed by your deletion.
  • You can email privacy@onlyfans.com about erasure, and legal or tax records can remain.
  • Save tax forms and your own original files before the login dies.

Deletion is permanent, and a few jobs only work while the login still does. Do those first, or you will be writing to support about money you can no longer see.

The help-center sequence is in this how to delete your OnlyFans account guide. Here is the order we would actually follow.

Disclosure: Dark-Ero is independent and has no OnlyFans deal. This is general information, not tax or legal advice.

Adults 18+ only.

Six things before you press it

Creators should withdraw. Earnings sit in a pending balance for seven days before they become withdrawable, and creators in a small set of countries wait 21 days at first, then seven days after four months.

The minimum withdrawal is 20 dollars on most methods, which you can confirm on the statements page. Payouts need the bank details already on the account, and a deleted login is a bad moment to discover a missing digit.

Fans should turn auto-renew off on every subscription from the Following page. Deleting the account ends access immediately, including days you already paid for, so cancel first if you want to use them.

Those renewal clicks are our how to cancel an OnlyFans subscription page. Do that list before you touch delete.

Wallet credits are money you loaded in advance, and the terms treat them as non-refundable. Use the balance or accept that it stays behind.

Creators should copy their own photos and videos to a drive they control. Fans should not download other people's posts, which the terms forbid.

US creators should download tax forms and payout records from the banking page before the account closes. If you will need a form for the current year after you leave, ask support how it will be sent, and keep the reply.

Remove saved cards if you want the extra step. Card removal does not prove renewals are off, so check the subscriptions anyway.

Delete in the browser

Sign in at the real site, including the second code if you use it. The control lives in account settings, and the wording may move, so look for delete account rather than a pause.

OnlyFans does not describe a way to freeze the profile and come back later. If you are unsure, turn renewals off, log out, and decide next week.

A forgotten password uses the forgot-password form on the site, and a lost second factor is a support ticket. You cannot delete what you cannot open, so fix the login before you assume the account is stuck forever.

What remains

Fans lose the profile and the feed when the deletion completes. Creators are different: once deletion starts, new subscriptions stop, and fans who already paid keep access until their period ends, which is when the account actually closes.

If someone renewed for a month the day before you pressed delete, the page can stay up for about that month. A longer bundle means a longer wait, and the help center describes no button that skips it.

Posts you made with another creator are not automatically removed from their page. Ask them, or ask support, if you need those taken down.

The privacy policy says personal data is kept only as long as reasonably necessary, decided case by case. Payment, tax, fraud and legal records are the usual reasons a row survives the profile.

You can ask for erasure by a ticket while you can still log in, or by email to privacy@onlyfans.com. Send it before you delete if you can, because a ticket needs a working account, and say whether you want a copy or a deletion.

People in the UK and the EU can point at the erasure right, and a company normally has a month to answer. California residents have a deletion right with a 45-day response clock, which the company can extend if it tells you.

If it will not close

Creators should check whether any paid subscription is still inside its period. That wait is the usual reason a creator account looks stuck, and support can explain a delay that does not match the statements.

What fans can still see in the meantime is limited, and our can OnlyFans creators see your email page is the list. They see usernames and messages, not your email.

The ranking site's can OnlyFans creators see your email note matches that split. Delete does not recall a chat you already sent.

Renewal settings, if you are not ready to delete, are in this how to cancel an OnlyFans subscription guide. A cancelled subscription is reversible until the period ends, and a deleted account is not.

Leaked copies are a different queue, covered in our OnlyFans leaks, scams and removal page. Closing the account does not pull a screenshot off someone else's site.

The ranking site's OnlyFans leaks, scams and removal guide is the parallel checklist. Save your originals before the OnlyFans copies go with the login.

Fees, the 20 percent cut and the 20 dollar minimum are in our OnlyFans review. Withdraw before you are under the minimum with no account left to top it up.

Company, statement and ID questions live on our is OnlyFans safe page. A deleted fan account does not delete a creator's identity file, and the reverse is also true.

If you might open a different platform later, our Fansly review is the next one we have written. Finish the OnlyFans withdrawal before you split your attention.

The category list is creator platforms. A new login elsewhere does not close this one.

More names are in this websites like OnlyFans roundup. Read what they keep before you upload the files you just saved.

Verdict

Withdraw, stop the renewals, save your own files and your tax papers, then delete in the browser. Creators should expect the page to linger until the last paid month runs out.

Ask for erasure while you can still open a ticket, and keep the reply. Some records are allowed to stay, and the profile is the part you can actually turn off.

FAQ

Can I delete OnlyFans in the app?

There is no official app for the account. Use a browser, on a computer or a phone, and sign in at the real site.

Should fans cancel subscriptions first?

Yes, if you want to use the days you already paid for. Deleting the account ends that access.

Turn auto-renew off, let the period finish, and delete after.

Why is my creator account still up?

Paid subscribers keep access until their period ends, and the account deletes after the last one expires. The help center does not describe a way to skip that wait.

Are wallet credits refunded?

The terms treat wallet credits as non-refundable. Use them or accept the loss before you delete.

Does deletion erase everything?

It removes the profile, and the privacy policy still allows some payment, tax and legal records to be kept. Email privacy@onlyfans.com if you want a specific erasure request on file.
